name: The Stellar Core
description: The heart of any craft that leaves Earth.

pages.title: Stellar Core
pages.text: The heart of any craft that leaves Earth. Made in a 5x5 [#](7A3C9A)[Mechanical Crafter grid](entry://glossary/mechanical_crafting)[#](). Press R over it in [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() to see the layout.

pages.title: The grid
pages.text:
- 1 Immortal Embryo (centre)
- 1 Nether Star
- 1 Hardened Precision Mechanism
- 4 Fiery Ingots
- 4 Enchanted Gravitite
- 4 Dragonskin
- 2 TFMG Circuit Boards
- 4 Titanium Plates

pages.title: Why each part
pages.text: Gravitite lifts the craft, fiery metal survives the burn, the Nether Star powers it, Dragonskin holds out the void, the Embryo keeps the crew alive and the circuit boards steer. Lose any one and the craft never leaves the ground.

pages.title: Rocket Station
pages.text: Now built around a Stellar Core, plus a Targeting Computer, circuits and titanium. See [#](2E5AAC)[Building a Rocket](entry://space/rocket_building)[#]().

pages.title: Dimensional Drive
pages.text: A Stellar Core ringed by Titanium Ingots and Precision Mechanisms. Takes an [#](2E5AAC)[Aeronautics ship](entry://flight/airships)[#]() to the planets.
The Stellar Navigator: a Stellar Core, Titanium, Levitite Blend, glass and redstone.
